description: Displays the 25-minute countdown timer with Reset button that allows students to return the timer to 25:00 and stop any running countdown

props.text: Displays the 25-minute countdown timer with Reset button that allows students to return the timer to 25:00 and stop any running countdown
Large, prominent display showing MM:SS format (e.g., 25:00, 24:59, 00:00)
Clearly labeled 'Reset' button positioned accessibly on the main screen, visible at all times regardless of timer state
Button to begin the countdown (dependency feature control)
Button to pause the running countdown (dependency feature control)
Display showing number of completed 25-minute sessions today
